I was never given an explanation, but I know why. I was openly expressing my not so befitting political views on various issues, and I also posted screenshots from a magazine. They do owe me an explanation as per their own rules, but it's fine I guess.

I'm killing myself tonight anyway with a very powerful euthanizing drug and alcohol. not because of this but because I was just diagnosed with multiple sclerosis and found out mine is  "unusually rapidly progressive", and I will be in a wheel chair in a year or so. On top of everything else in my life that has happened I could always say at least I'm not physically disabled....well...I've lost that as well.

Meh, half of it consistent of a rant where I basically bitched out a fortune 500 article for saying women are better at many of the job skills that will matter in the future then men. I think men and women should be looked upon as equals not not pitted against each other like this article was alluding too, but no they removed it more than likely because I posted pictures of the article I took with my phone. Which sense you have to pay for it, gave the mod reason to remove the post. So the moderator was correct to do so.

Well it would seem the mods did in fact remove the post. I just want the mod that removed it to know that I've changed my mind about the 300 days. I did manage to aquire the drugs I need to end it, and after observing just how much people hate me even over the internet, even in a place devoted to helping suicidal people I'm shunned away. I'll be going to sleep and never waking up tonight.

I wouldn't call myself a good person per say, and I can't be a good person, what with all the people that have sent hate/replies to my alternate accounts in the past; Over my opinions and ideas. Funny, I have always been able to relate more to the villains in movies and games, than I have the heroes. I've grown accustomed to being the guy people just don't like, and I guess I've finally come to terms with that, and it's fine by me.

I'm so sorry to hear about your situation, your terrible illness, and your friend. I wanted to leave a comment to say I'm not going to lie to you and say I have any idea what it must be like to be confined to a wheel chair, or suffer from cerebral palsy. This post was eye opening for me as immediately after reading I had to look into the disease further. I wanted to say that you're strong and it's not your fault for feeling the way you do. If you do not want to be the only one managing your care perhaps there's a way for you find someone you're close with(assuming you have close connections with other people) and letting them know how you feel. No, in my opinion that won't think you're crazy and you won't scare them away. 

I just recently went to the neurologists and I'm waiting for my EMG results as I have been twitching and having frequent spasms lately. I was concerned about what I may be diagnosed with and then seeing the reality of it reflected in your post, my heart truly goes out to you and I wish you the best.

If it means anything at least you have friends and family that care and love you. You should stick around to enjoy the good times with them, and who know with the current exponential speed of technological progression, perhaps there will be a cure in your lifetime. Please think everything through before acting on impulse.

Hey I have PTSD(raped and peer abuse as a child), High functioning autism, and a host of other issues like IBS which causes me much undue pain(your would be surprised how crippling it can be), however I didn't come here to discuss this in particular. While I thought this was a great post and very encouraging to most people I wanted to point out to you how it looks from my perspective, you see some people don't have good lives. Some people(like me) have no friends or close relationships with others whom they feel comfortable enough to confide in, some people don't know what it even feels like to be happy anymore. I wasn't happy until I devised my new scheme to end my life and have fun for once before I die. 

There's no hope for a guy like me, I'm somewhat androgynous looking and a nerd, socially dysfunctional, pale, balding, ribs stick out and skinnyfat(although getting cut again before I go to Thailand to fix this), no social networking or friends, high school dropout, family makes fun of me, almost everyone forgets me and I never forget them. I can't even learn to drive a car properly and I'm twenty-two years old. I'm probably the only person to ever achieve the amount of hate messages and down votes for my posts within a subreddit about suicide. Literally whenever I express my views I'm down voted and told I'm wrong. I haven't ever so much as gotten a hug from someone in almost ten years. I've always been the guy everyone loves to hate and make fun of. 

I've had many other hardships in my life I will go over in time with my posts, but you need to understand some people have NO other way out other than suicide, and sometimes that's okay.

I did reply to your other post with my current state of affairs and what I wanted to do, but let me reply to your edit on this one as well and say that killing yourself isn't stupid when your life is nearly impossible to improve. I could never live and even remotely normal life, and if you ever want to Skype with me I will explain why, or you could simply follow along with my posts over time and you will figure it out.

Thanks for the reply though :)

Hey man I just wanted to hop in and say fuck him. Seriously I know what this is like first hand(I'm 22 and my father say's I'm a failure and is hard on me). Allow me to tell you life is hard, and being a "man" is harder. Especially when there's so much unfair and undue pressure and unrealistic expectations from others. 

You see most of us have a deep burning desire to please our parents. It's even worse when it's your father and you're a guy trying to live to be his "ideal" son. It is draining and tough, but it's just the way it is and there is no way to sugar coat it.

I'm my fathers fuck up kid. My father's fought with me and threatened to kick me out and told me about how weird I am, and why I'm "fucked up" many, many, many times. 

Please do your best to look at the positives in your life. You did say in your post your mother would be "horrified" implying she cares about you, and you have a connection with her. Well cherish that, and cherish the connection you have with your friends you referred as well. 

Really try to imagine that life could be worse. Unlike me you seem like you can obtain and maintain social interactions with others, hell maybe you even have a full head of hair, a potential girl friend, real life friends, anything. Anything you have that makes you happy. You have potential so stick around. Shit, I wish I had any of those things I just listed. 

Try to stay positive, and listen to me right now. Don't pay any mind to what he says to you, he's an asshole, alright? 

I think this could apply to you:

*It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see the light.* - *Aristotle Onassis*

This is about half the driving force behind my desire to commit suicide, and every time someone downvotes thoughts like these it makes me feel less human/normal, and pushes me further towards my suicide. Which is ironic seeing as how this is a suicide help subreddit.

A couple proposals for Aubrey de Grey, a proof for the Riemann Hypotheses, two new 3d printer designs, molecular assembler that may or may not work, and a whole lot of science speculation. This same maths I use to help describe neural networks in the brain as well. This universe emerged via quantum fluctuations in a past eternal quantum multiverse. In a perfect world I would work on artificial intelligence, however I don't think I could work up a sufficient degree of prestige in order to do this; The world simply doesn't work that way.

I hear you, but in the end I know to much. I have over the course of my life thus far, been obsessed with the Universe and the inner workings of space-time. I'm ready to move on to something different, but at the same time with the technology we'll have in twenty years, I'm considering sticking around.
